fixed_assets.title: Fixed assets
fixed_assets.name: Name
fixed_assets.start_hint: Starting adds these asset classes, each linked to accounts in your chart. You can rename, change or archive them later.
fixed_assets.start_defaults: Each month, depreciation is prepared for you to review before it posts. You can change this in settings at any time.
fixed_assets.run_mode_hint: What happens on the run day each month.
fixed_assets.threshold_hint: Lines below this amount per unit are flagged as possible expenses. Leave it empty for no threshold.
fixed_assets.first_managed_period_hint: Lines dated before this month were handled before the register started and are not offered for registration.
fixed_assets.classes_hint: Click a value to change it. Archived classes keep their assets but are not offered for new ones.
fixed_assets.contributed_bill_hint: The account the contribution is credited to, usually owner's capital.
fixed_assets.kind_hint.opening: An asset you owned before this register started. Enter its cost and what was already depreciated. No journal is posted.
fixed_assets.kind_hint.contributed: An asset given to the business without a bill. Its cost is posted against the credit account you choose.
fixed_assets.kind_hint.physical: Track an asset without any figures. You can add its financial details later.
fixed_assets.empty_hint: Assets come from bill lines posted to an asset account, or you can add them by hand.
fixed_assets.register_hint: Every asset you own, newest first. Open one to see its figures, sources and movements.
fixed_assets.intake_hint: Bill and journal lines posted to an asset account that no asset has claimed yet.
fixed_assets.line_gone: This line is no longer waiting. It may already be registered.
fixed_assets.link_hint: Split this depreciation between the assets it belongs to. The amounts must add up to the line.
fixed_assets.no_active_assets: There are no active assets to link this to.
fixed_assets.reason_hint: Saved with the line so anyone can see why it was left out.
fixed_assets.below_threshold: This line is below the capitalisation threshold. It may be an expense.
fixed_assets.undo_hint: Reverses this asset's journals and returns its source lines to the list. Possible only while nothing else has happened to the asset.
fixed_assets.runs_hint: Monthly depreciation: {mode}, on day {day} of each month.
fixed_assets.runs_empty: No depreciation has run yet. Choose a month that has ended and review it.
fixed_assets.run_through_hint: Every month from the one after the last posted run through this month is posted, one journal per month.
fixed_assets.run_missing: There is no run for this month.
fixed_assets.month_posts_nothing: Nothing to post for this month.
fixed_assets.nothing_to_depreciate: Nothing to depreciate yet. Add or register an asset first.
fixed_assets.held_title: Assets held out of this run
fixed_assets.reverse_run_hint: Reverses this month's journal and the depreciation it put on each asset. Only the latest run can be reversed, while its month is open.
fixed_assets.action_hint.fix_account: The asset's depreciation or accumulated depreciation account no longer takes postings. Choose another on its class or the asset.
fixed_assets.action_hint.review_source: A journal this asset's figures came from was voided. Review it, then correct the asset.
fixed_assets.action_hint.enter_reading: A month has no units recorded. Record the reading below.
fixed_assets.action_hint.skip: A month is skipped. Withdraw the skip below when it should be depreciated.
fixed_assets.attention_hint: These assets post nothing until what holds them is cleared. The next run catches them up.
fixed_assets.skips_hint: A skipped month posts no depreciation for this asset. The next run after the skip is withdrawn catches it up.
fixed_assets.run_day_hint: The day of the month, 1 to 28, on which last month's run is prepared or posted.
fixed_assets.notice.ready.title: Depreciation ready to post
fixed_assets.notice.ready.body: Depreciation for {month} is ready to post: {total}.
fixed_assets.notice.paused.title: Automatic depreciation posting paused
fixed_assets.notice.paused.body: Automatic posting is paused because fixed assets was turned off. Post this run by hand to resume it.
fixed_assets.notice.no_user.title: Automatic depreciation posting needs a user
fixed_assets.notice.no_user.body: The user who chose automatic posting can no longer post journals. Choose another user by setting posting to automatic again.
fixed_assets.notice.attention.title: Assets held out of depreciation
fixed_assets.notice.attention.body: {count} assets are held out of depreciation until what holds them is cleared.
